```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour="green") +
  xlab("date") +
  ylab("metric value") +
  ggtitle("metric value by date")
```
